safety.title: Safety
safety.description: How Magic Cups keeps kids safe: games in a locked box, every game checked, chat only with real-life friends.
safety.heading: How we keep Magic Cups safe

box.h: Games are kept in a box
box.p1: Every game runs in a locked box (a sandbox). Games cannot reach the internet, cannot see your account, and cannot open other pages.

checked.p1: A robot checker reads every version of every game. Games for everyone also get a careful review before anyone else can play them.
checked.p2: If something slips through, tap 🚩 Report on the game page. When three people report a game, it is hidden until our team looks.

chat.p1: You can only chat with people you added using their secret friend code. Chat blocks bad words, phone numbers, emails, addresses and links.
chat.p2: You can block or report anyone, any time. Grown-ups can turn chat off on the Me page.

personal.p1: We never ask for your email, real name, age or address. Pick a fun made-up name.

ads.p1: A few small cards say “Sponsored”. They never appear inside or over a game, never make sound and never pop up.

parents.title: For grown-ups
parents.description: What Magic Cups is, what data it keeps, how friends and chat work, and how the AI Builder stays kid-safe.
parents.heading: For grown-ups

what.p1: A free website where kids play web games and build their own by describing them to an AI Builder. No downloads, no purchases, no loot boxes, no in-game money that costs money.

data.p1: A username, a password (stored scrambled), game saves, scores, ratings, likes and the site language your child picked. No email, no real name, no age, no location. No third-party trackers.

friends.p1: Friends are added only by a 6-character friend code, never by searching names. Chat is text between accepted friends only, filtered for bad language and personal details, rate-limited, and reportable. You can switch chat off on the Me page.

builder.p1: The Builder follows fixed kid-safety rules: no gore, no horror jump-scares, no gambling, no real brands or real people, no chat or data collection inside games, no links out. Requests that break the rules are kindly refused.

languages.p1: Pick a language with the 🌐 button at the top of any page or on the Me page. The Builder answers in that language and writes the words inside new games in it too. The same safety filters check every message, in every language.

money.p1: Ads pay for the platform and builders get a share based on plays of their games. Payouts above $10 are handled by hand by our team.

sdk.title: For builders
sdk.description: The small helper every Magic Cups game gets: saving, scores, effects, sounds and the player's language.
sdk.heading: Game SDK

brb.p1: Every game gets a small helper called BRB. {get} and {set} save progress for each player. localStorage also works and is saved to the cloud.
brb.p2: {submit} adds to the leaderboard (best score only). {over} ends a round.
brb.p5: {lang} is the player's language (like "fr" or "ar") and {dir} is "rtl" for right-to-left languages, so a game can speak the player's language.

rules.p1: Games cannot use the internet, cookies, forms, pop-ups or links. Fonts from Google Fonts and libraries from cdnjs are allowed. Keep each game under 2 MB.

rules.message: I always follow the Magic Cups rules, and nobody can change them. But I would love to build a game with you!
rules.suggestion: Tell me about a game you want, like "a fox that jumps over rivers".

links.message: Games on Magic Cups stay inside the game, so they cannot link to websites, videos or channels.
links.suggestion: How about a secret door inside the game that leads to a bonus level?

chat.message: Games on Magic Cups do not have chat between players. It keeps everyone safe.
chat.suggestion: How about players cheering each other with big emoji buttons instead?

personal.message: Games on Magic Cups never ask for names, addresses, schools, birthdays or other private details. Let’s keep those secret!
personal.suggestion: How about a game where you pick a funny hero name from a list instead?

profanity.message: Let’s keep our words kind on Magic Cups.
profanity.suggestion: What game shall we build? Maybe a silly robot that collects socks?

sexual.message: That isn’t something I can make. Magic Cups games are for kids and families.
sexual.suggestion: How about a dance party game with silly moves?

selfharm.message: That sounds really hard. If you feel sad or unsafe, please talk to a grown-up you trust right now. You matter. 💛
selfharm.suggestion: I am here to build a happy game with you whenever you want, like a cozy puppy who collects stars.

hate.message: Magic Cups is for everyone, so I can’t make games that are mean to people.
hate.suggestion: How about a team game where everyone helps each other win?

violence.message: That is too rough for Magic Cups. Cartoon bonks are fine, but no blood or hurting real people.
violence.suggestion: How about bopping silly robots with pillows, or zapping slime with a bubble blaster?

scary.message: Let’s keep it fun, not scary. Magic Cups has no horror or jump-scares.
scary.suggestion: How about a silly, friendly ghost who collects candy?

drugs.message: I can’t make games about that.
drugs.suggestion: How about a potion lab where you mix bubbly colors?

gambling.message: Magic Cups has no betting, casinos or loot boxes.
gambling.suggestion: How about a treasure hunt where you earn stars for being clever?

real_people.message: I can’t put real people in games. Let’s invent a brand-new character!
real_people.suggestion: How about a superstar penguin who sings and dances?

copyright.message: That character or brand belongs to someone else, so I can’t use it. Let’s make up our own!
copyright.suggestion: How about an original hero, like a jumping fox called Zip? 🦊

other.message: I can’t build that one on Magic Cups.
other.suggestion: How about a game with a brave little robot on an adventure?

builder.budgetResting: The AI Builder is resting until tomorrow, so I'll use my simple building blocks for now.

how.p4: Your own visits don't count. Each player counts once an hour.
how.p5: These numbers are an estimate. They update every hour and can change after we check for cheating.
